occurrence_sentence: Scientists at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) under the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), in partnership with a collaborative team from Tsinghua University, helmed by Ma Xiongfeng, as well as Fudan University, led by Zhou You, have made remarkable strides in the development and precise measurement of scalable multipartite entangled states.
